newsitem.title: USA: Prudential to open Jacksonville center.
newsitem.headline: Prudential to open Jacksonville center.

text.p: Prudential HealthCare, a unit of The Prudential Insurance Company of America, said Thursday it selected Jacksonville, Fla. as a site for one of its national service centers.
Prudential HealthCare said it expects to employ about 1,400 people in the service center by the end of the year.
The national service center will comprise several key functions, including claims, billing and eligibility, and member services, the company said.
The announcement is part of a national health care operations initiative to consolidate member services, billing and claims functions into four national service centers in 1997, the company said.
Houston has also been selected as a national service center location and the company said the remaining two locations will be announced in the near future.
